subject: general
question: Who was the first European president of the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**George Yule**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **George Yule** was the first European president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was elected as the president in the year **1888**.
 
• The Indian National Congress was founded in **1885** by A.O. Hume, Dadabhai Naoroji, and others.
 
• George Yule's presidency marked a significant moment as it showed the inclusiveness and broad appeal of the Congress during the British rule in India.
 
• Yule was a businessman and had served as the President of the Bengal Chamber of Commerce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Annie Besant** was the first woman president of the Indian National Congress, elected in **1917**.
 
• **A.O. Hume** was one of the founders of the Indian National Congress but never served as its president.
 
• **Alfred Webb** was another European who served as the president of the Indian National Congress, elected in **1894**.
 
• The Indian National Congress played a crucial role in the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• Over the years, the Congress has had many prominent leaders who have significantly contributed to India's political landscape.
